name: list_series
title: List recorded series
description: Lists the time series the heating monitor records for the home: id, name, unit, native sampling interval in seconds, and the earliest and latest timestamps available (ISO 8601, Europe/London). All series share one interval and one time span. Not recorded, so not listed: target flow temperature, and any defrost or off state -- operating mode is the two 0/1 series heating_running and dhw_running, and exists only for days since it began being logged.

name: get_series
title: Get raw or downsampled series
description: Returns one or more series over a time range as compact columnar JSON: { interval_seconds, timestamps: [...], series: { id: [...] } }, one value per interval, null where nothing was recorded. Timestamps mark the start of each interval. Units are in the series ids (_w watts, _c degrees Celsius, _lph litres per hour). Omit interval_seconds to get at most 1000 points per series; a request for more than 5000 points per series is refused with the interval that would fit. A range may cover at most 31 days. For questions about cycling, run lengths, starts per hour or COP, use summarise_cycles instead: it works on every raw sample and returns the answer directly, where this returns points to work it out from.

start.description: Start of the range, inclusive, ISO 8601. With an offset or Z it is taken as given; without one (2026-10-08T06:00) it is wall-clock time in `timezone`.

end.description: End of the range, exclusive, ISO 8601. With an offset or Z it is taken as given; without one (2026-10-08T06:00) it is wall-clock time in `timezone`.

interval_seconds.description: Width of each returned interval in seconds. Omit to have one chosen.

aggregation.description: How the samples in each interval are reduced. Default mean.

timezone.description: Zone for timestamps without an offset and for all timestamps returned. The device knows only these two; for any other zone pass timestamps with an explicit offset. Default Europe/London.

name: summarise_cycles
title: Summarise compressor cycles
description: Detects compressor runs in a time range and summarises them. Prefer this over get_series for any question about cycling, short-cycling, run and off lengths, starts per hour, or COP. A run is a stretch with electrical input at or above on_threshold_w; runs closer together than min_gap_seconds are merged, runs shorter than min_run_seconds dropped, and a run is split where the operating mode changes (e.g. hot water to heating). Each run has: start, end (ISO 8601), duration_min, mode (heating | dhw | other | unknown), compressor_start (false for a changeover from another mode with no stop), avg_heat_w, max_heat_w, avg_elec_w, heat_kwh, elec_kwh, cop (heat energy / electrical energy), avg_flow_c, avg_return_c, avg_outdoor_c, flow_at_stop_c, off_time_after_min, excluded_heat_samples, clipped_by_period. The summary has heating_starts_per_hour, median run and off lengths in minutes, COP overall and split by heating and hot water, kWh totals, electricity used outside runs, and mean_outdoor_c. Heat samples that are physically implausible -- above 3x rated_output_w, or implying an instantaneous COP above 10 -- are left out of heat averages, energy and COP, and counted in excluded_heat_samples. Target flow temperature is not recorded, so there is no target at stop. A range may cover at most 31 days; set include_runs to false for long ranges where only the summary is wanted.

start.description: Start of the period, inclusive, ISO 8601. With an offset or Z it is taken as given; without one (2026-10-08T06:00) it is wall-clock time in `timezone`.

end.description: End of the period, exclusive, ISO 8601. With an offset or Z it is taken as given; without one (2026-10-08T06:00) it is wall-clock time in `timezone`.

on_threshold_w.description: Electrical input, W, at or above which the compressor counts as running. Default 300.

min_gap_seconds.description: Runs separated by less than this many seconds are merged into one. Default 120.

min_run_seconds.description: Runs shorter than this many seconds are dropped. Default 60.

rated_output_w.description: The heat pump's rated heat output, W. Heat samples above 3x this are treated as metering artefacts. Default 8000; set it to the unit's actual rating.

include_runs.description: Whether to list every run as well as the summary. Default true.

timezone.description: Zone for timestamps without an offset and for all timestamps returned. The device knows only these two; for any other zone pass timestamps with an explicit offset. Default Europe/London.

name: compare_periods
title: Compare two periods
description: Runs summarise_cycles over two periods and returns the two period summaries side by side, for before/after comparisons such as a heating-curve change. Each summary carries mean_outdoor_c, degrees Celsius: check the two are close before attributing a difference in COP or cycling to the change, since both depend strongly on outdoor temperature. Individual runs are not returned; call summarise_cycles on a period for those.

start.description: Start of the first period, inclusive, ISO 8601. With an offset or Z it is taken as given; without one (2026-10-08T06:00) it is wall-clock time in `timezone`.

end.description: End of the first period, exclusive, ISO 8601. With an offset or Z it is taken as given; without one (2026-10-08T06:00) it is wall-clock time in `timezone`.

start.description: Start of the second period, inclusive, ISO 8601. With an offset or Z it is taken as given; without one (2026-10-08T06:00) it is wall-clock time in `timezone`.

end.description: End of the second period, exclusive, ISO 8601. With an offset or Z it is taken as given; without one (2026-10-08T06:00) it is wall-clock time in `timezone`.

on_threshold_w.description: Electrical input, W, at or above which the compressor counts as running. Default 300.

min_gap_seconds.description: Runs separated by less than this many seconds are merged into one. Default 120.

min_run_seconds.description: Runs shorter than this many seconds are dropped. Default 60.

rated_output_w.description: The heat pump's rated heat output, W. Heat samples above 3x this are treated as metering artefacts. Default 8000; set it to the unit's actual rating.

timezone.description: Zone for timestamps without an offset and for all timestamps returned. The device knows only these two; for any other zone pass timestamps with an explicit offset. Default Europe/London.
